// Greeting
default
{
state_entry
()
{
llSetTouchText
(
"Greet"
);
}
touch_start
(
integer
num
)
{
list
TimeStamp
=
llParseString2List
(
llGetTimestamp
(),[
"-"
,
":"
],[
"T"
]);
//Get timestamp and split into parts in a list
integer
Hour
=
llList2Integer
(
TimeStamp
,
4
);
if
(
Hour
<
12
)
llSay
(
PUBLIC_CHANNEL
,
"Good Morning, Oliver Sintim-Aboagye!"
);
else
if
(
Hour
<
17
)
llSay
(
PUBLIC_CHANNEL
,
"Good Afternoon, "
+
llDetectedName
(
0
));
else
llSay
(
PUBLIC_CHANNEL
,
"Good Evening, "
+
llKey2Name
(
llDetectedKey
(
0
)));
}
}
